event.title: Resolve the Event
event.desc: Trigger the printed event. On an opponent's card this is the event-first branch — you choose how to spend the Ops afterwards.

space.title: Space Race Attempt

opsCoup.title: Operations: Coup Attempt

opsRealign.title: Operations: Realignment
opsRealign.desc: Spend {{ops}} on realignment rolls — opposed dice.

unlabelled.title: ⚠ Unlabelled resolution mode {{mode}} ({{name}})
unlabelled.desc: The viewer has no label for this mode — the engine's Resolution enum has changed and web/ui/src/action_hud.ts was not updated.

influence.desc: Place influence markers in adjacent countries

coup.desc: Roll die to remove enemy influence and add own

realign.desc: Opposed die rolls to remove enemy influence
